offering_description.value: Designs fabless low-power, high-precision mixed-signal integrated circuits, mainly audio codecs, smart amplifiers, haptic drivers and power/camera controllers. Sells them to consumer electronics makers, especially smartphone OEMs, which build them into devices. Chips are made by third-party foundries.

primary_products.value: audio codecs; smart speaker amplifiers; haptic drivers; MEMS microphone and voice processing chips; power management and camera controller chips

customer_segment.value: B2B: smartphone, laptop, tablet, wearable and other consumer electronics manufacturers and their contract manufacturers

end_markets.value: consumer electronics; smartphones; laptops and PCs; wearables; automotive and industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: integrated circuits sold in volume to device makers

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: designs chips made by outsourced foundries, sold to consumer electronics OEMs and ODMs

geography_served.value: global: Customers mainly in Asia, plus North America and Europe, headquartered in Austin, Texas

specialization.value: related lines: audio, haptics, voice and power mixed-signal chips sharing customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to large OEM customers; distributors / dealers: electronics distributors serving smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus export controls and environmental/product compliance for electronics
